newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Petronor says strike called Mar 21-27.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Petronor says strike called Mar 21-27.

text.p: Workers at two Petronor refineries and one fluid catalytic cracker plant in Bilbao, Spain are to strike from 1600 GMT on Friday March 21 to 0500 GMT on Friday March 27, a spokesman for Petronor said on Thursday.
The output of the refineries was around 180,000-190,000 bpd, the spokesman said.
The Petronor spokesman said the strike would have a limited impact on the firm's income because it has excess capacity.
"It won't have much effect as we can always step up production to compensate for the reduced output," he said.
Workers are striking over wage agreements, he added.
An oil trader who requested anonymity agreed the strike should have a limited impact.

"Recently Petronor seems to be having strikes relatively frequently. But in terms of how it should impact (the market) we don't think it will be important. Petronor is a lot less important that Repsol itself or Cepsa," the trader said.
Petronor is a unit of the Repsol group.
